svg.title: RAGAS evaluation dashboard with four gauge cards
svg.desc: A 2 by 2 grid of gauge meter cards showing four RAGAS metrics: Faithfulness at 0.82 in the green healthy zone, Answer relevancy at 0.75 in the yellow monitor zone, Context precision at 0.68 in the yellow monitor zone, and Context recall at 0.71 in the yellow monitor zone.
svg.text: Is the answer grounded in retrieved context?
Does the answer address the question?
Did retrieval capture all needed information?
Run RAGAS weekly on a sample of 50–100 queries. A consistent drop in any metric is your earliest warning signal.
